provenance.title: Systematic TB screening — who is presumptive TB, and who is eligible for preventive therapy
provenance.primarySource: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 2: screening (2021), and the WHO TB SMART guidelines / DAK
provenance.why: Screening is the step that decides whether to investigate for TB at all. A symptom screen missed sends an infectious patient home; the same screen, when negative in a person living with HIV, is precisely the gate that makes them eligible for preventive therapy. The one screen therefore has two exits — presumptive TB to diagnosis, and screen-negative to TPT — and both matter.

sourceVerification.note: The WHO TB DAK is NOT vendored under docs/reference/who-dak/MANIFEST.json. Authored against the published Module 2 (2021); ships ENGINEERING_SEED until the primary text is vendored and each screen is checked against it.

rules.name: Symptom screen positive — presumptive TB
rules.message: Presumptive TB — at least one screening symptom is present.
rules.explanation: Any of current cough, fever, night sweats or weight loss makes a person presumptive TB and triggers a diagnostic test. The four-symptom screen is the WHO screen for the general population and for people living with HIV.
rules.requiredAction: Send a rapid molecular diagnostic test (Xpert MTB/RIF) on sputum; consider urine LF-LAM in a person living with HIV who is seriously ill or has a low CD4.
sourceRefs: WHO consolidated TB guidelines Module 2 — symptom screening

adaptation.whoStatement: Any of cough, fever, night sweats or weight loss defines presumptive TB and triggers diagnostic testing.

testCases.name: all four absent is a negative screen

rules.name: Screen-negative person living with HIV — assess for TB preventive therapy
rules.message: Negative TB symptom screen in a person living with HIV — assess for TB preventive therapy.
rules.explanation: A negative four-symptom screen in a person living with HIV makes active TB unlikely and is the gate to TB preventive therapy. Ruling out active TB before TPT is essential — giving TPT to someone with active TB risks resistance.
rules.requiredAction: Having excluded active TB, assess eligibility for TB preventive therapy (see the TPT content) and offer it.
sourceRefs: WHO consolidated TB guidelines Module 2 — screening as the gate to TPT

adaptation.whoStatement: A negative symptom screen in PLHIV excludes active TB for TPT purposes and triggers TPT assessment.

testCases.name: PLHIV with a symptom is not (investigate active TB)
HIV-negative does not take this rule
